note: A real PMS multiplexes TLS and plain HTTP on the same TCP port. The first byte decides: 0x16 is a TLS handshake record, anything else is read as HTTP.
sni: ignored -- no SNI and a bogus SNI both complete with the same certificate

certificate.note: The same 32-hex hash the GDM reply's Host line carries. plex.tv issues it to a claimed server, so rex cannot mint one: the operator supplies it.

plain_side: identical API and identical response header block on the same port
